text:
anya: Hey team — kickoff for the AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace quickstart. Need check on initial creds, legal signoff, and packaging artifacts. Who's available?

devin: I can take the AWS side (AMI + billing metadata). Need the SKU and trial config from product.

marcos: I'll own GCP marketplace entry and OAuth scopes. Can we confirm pubportal access?

laura: Azure SAS + private offer contact is queued, but need legal-approved offer text from @sarah-legal.

sarah-legal: Working on the EULA/terms update. Draft ETA tomorrow EOD. Any special retention/KMS language required?

anya: Yes — customers ask for KMS integration note and data-retention in private deployments. Add a short blurb about no customer data exfil on hosted plan.

devin: For AWS, I also need the agent AMI naming convention and signing key. Proposed: redwood-inference-ami-<region>-v1. Thoughts?

marcos: That naming works. For GCP, I need the service account roles list to prefill publisher onboarding form. Sample roles: roles/compute.admin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/storage.objectViewer.

laura: Azure needs Managed Identity + Contributor on the resource group for deployment automation. Also need marketplace test tenant info.

anya: OK action items: (1) devin: AMI naming + billing metadata (2) marcos: service account role list + oauth redirect URIs (3) laura: test tenant + SAS offer draft (4) sarah-legal: EULA + quick legal blurb.

sarah-legal: I'll include the KMS paragraph and a short acceptable-use snippet. Will share redlined doc in this thread when ready.

devin: Posting preliminary billing metadata sample:
```json
{
  "sku": "redwood-hosted-basic",
  "pricing_unit": "monthly",
  "trial_days": 14,
  "metering_dimensions": ["api_requests","embed_units"]
}
```

anya: Nice. Include a note about meter granularity (per-1k tokens) for pricing page.

marcos: One more ask — partner portal requires icons at 128x128 and a 1024x512 hero. Who owns creative? @marketing?

laura: Tag @marketing in our handoff doc. We have a basic logo but need localized text for EU pages.

anya: For rollout: plan a gated publish — internal staging -> private offer -> public listing. We should do a dry run on staging this week.

devin: Can cloud-bot create staging entitlements?

cloud-bot: staging-entitlement created: redwood-marketplace-staging-2024-06, creds sent to #vault. :white_check_mark:

marcos: I'll try the publisher flow with the staging entitlement today and report issues.

sarah-legal: Shared draft in Google Drive: https://go.example.com/redwood-marketplace-eula-draft — please comment.

anya: Great. Let's reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for a quick sync. If anyone hits blockers before then, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

devin: Adding tests: billing export + entitlement activation + 1st-run AMI smoke test.

laura: I'll prepare Azure private-offer docs and a short rollback playbook.

anya: Thanks all — I'll update the onboarding checklist with today's action items and link to assets.

marcos: filing a bug if publisher portal rejects our IAM roles -> will post thread.

cloud-bot: reminder scheduled: marketplace-sync-standup tomorrow 10:00 PT

anya: End of thread for now.
